title: Lightly Weathered Copper
description: Renames Exposed to Lightly Weathered in copper blocks.
body:
Waxed Lightly Weathered Cut Copper Stairs. The whole reason why I made this resource pack. This resource pack renames Exposed to Lightly Weathered in copper blocks.
This pack supports all English languages.![waxed lightly weathered cut copper stairs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/100b3cc5eb71d22c95a6597c283e519dea8dd5e3.png)
